international.title: Rohingya who escaped Myanmar’s genocide tell their stories
international.summary: Survivors recount rivers red with blood and burning nearby villages serving as an urgent warning to flee their homes Smoke was often the signal to run – seen from a distance, it was the indication for Rohingya that a neighbouring village was under attack and that theirs would be next. In other places, they saw the rivers run red and would pull out the bodies, perform quick burial rites and then flee. Continue reading...
